      - reduce
      - divide
      - complete
      - discard
      - move_to_backlog
  input_contract:
    required:
      - completed_items
      - incomplete_items
      - blockers
      - decisions
    optional:
      - evidence
      - learnings
      - feedback
      - new_demands
  execution:
    - order: 1
      action: reconcile
      output: reconciled_week
    - order: 2
      action: update
      output: updated_state_and_backlog
    - order: 3
      action: regenerate
      output: next_week_draft
  output_contract:
    required:
      - completed_items
      - incomplete_items
      - blockers
      - decisions
      - learnings
      - updated_backlog
      - next_week_priorities
      - new_desk_os_instance
  definition_of_done: >
    O estado da semana foi reconciliado, as pendências possuem destino,
    o backlog foi atualizado e uma nova instância do DESK-OS pode ser gerada.
# =====================================================================
# 09. WORKSPACE E QR SEMÂNTICO
# =====================================================================
workspace:
  owner_role: R3
  supporting_role: R5
  semantic_qr:
    id: QR-SEMANTIC-ROUTER
    type: stable_contextual_router
    implementation_status: to_be_specified
    epistemic_status: LACUNA
    purpose: >
      Resolver usuário, projeto, semana, workflow, comando e ação sem vincular
      a folha permanentemente a uma URL frágil ou fornecedor específico.
    interaction_flow:
      - order: 1
        action: scan
        output: qr_token
      - order: 2
        action: identify_user
        output: user_context
      - order: 3
        action: identify_project
        output: project_context
      - order: 4
        action: identify_week
        output: sprint_context
      - order: 5
        action: identify_action
        output: requested_action
      - order: 6
        action: open_workflow
        output: active_workflow
      - order: 7
        action: confirm_external_action
        output: action_confirmation
      - order: 8
        action: execute_or_open
        output: action_result
      - order: 9
        action: register
        output: traceability_record
    minimum_payload:
      - token_id
      - user_id
      - project_id
      - sprint_id
      - workflow_id
      - command
      - action
      - context_reference
      - issued_at
      - expires_at
      - version
    security_rules:
      credentials_in_qr_forbidden: true
      sensitive_personal_data_in_qr_forbidden: true
      external_action_requires_confirmation: true
      expired_token_must_fail_closed: true
      token_must_be_revocable: true
      access_must_be_logged: true
    routing_rules:
      stable_router_required: true
      provider_independent_token: true
      direct_provider_url_forbidden: true
      destination_may_change_without_reprinting: true
      fallback_action_required: true
    fallback:
      type: human_readable_command
      action: display_command_and_context
      works_without_router: true
# =====================================================================
# 10. MAPA DE DONOS
# =====================================================================
ownership_map:
  weekly_instance:
    owner_role: R5
    supporting_role: R3
    command: /generate-week
  weekly_objective:
    owner_role: R3
  priority_deliverables:
    owner_role: R2
    supporting_role: R3
  project_state:
    owner_role: R3
  workflow_execution:
    owner_role: R4
  new_artifact_creation:
    owner_role: R5
  weekly_grid:
    owner_role: R3
    generated_by: /generate-week
  daily_brief:
    owner_role: R2
    command: /bom-dia
  next_three_actions:
    owner_role: R3
    command: /proximas-3
  close_day:
    owner_role: R4
    supporting_role: R3
  recycle:
    owner_role: R5
    supporting_role: R3
    command: /recycle
  qr_router:
    owner_role: R3
    supporting_role: R5
# =====================================================================
# 11. GATES DE QUALIDADE
# =====================================================================
quality_gates:
  - id: GATE-DESKOS-OWNERSHIP
    name: Propriedade dos campos
    pass_when:
      - every_operational_field_has_owner
      - every_command_exists_in_card_1
      - every_skill_exists_in_resource_registry
      - every_source_of_truth_is_declared
    fail_action: assign_or_remove_field
  - id: GATE-DESKOS-UTILITY
    name: Utilidade operacional
    pass_when:
      - every_item_supports_action_decision_workflow_or_result
      - every_operational_block_has_next_action
      - no_decorative_field_without_function
      - paper_remains_useful_offline
    fail_action: remove_or_redesign_item
  - id: GATE-DESKOS-WORKFLOW
    name: Contrato de workflow
    inherits_from: GATE-WORKFLOW
    pass_when:
      - exactly_three_workflows_exist
      - each_workflow_has_exactly_three_steps
      - each_workflow_has_trigger
      - each_workflow_has_input_contract
      - each_workflow_has_output_contract
      - each_workflow_has_definition_of_done
      - each_workflow_has_owner
      - each_workflow_has_access_action
    fail_action: return_to_workflow_design
  - id: GATE-DESKOS-RUNTIME
    name: Integridade da instância
    pass_when:
      - runtime_values_are_not_invented
      - missing_values_are_marked_as_gaps
      - week_and_project_are_identified
      - current_phase_and_gate_are_consistent
      - next_action_is_unique
    fail_action: block_generation_and_report_gaps
  - id: GATE-DESKOS-QR
    name: QR semântico
    pass_when:
      - stable_router_is_used
      - token_contains_only_minimum_data
      - credentials_are_absent
      - expiration_is_defined
      - fallback_is_available
      - external_actions_require_confirmation
    fail_action: disable_qr_and_show_text_command
  - id: GATE-DESKOS-RECYCLE
    name: Continuidade do ciclo
    pass_when:
      - completed_items_are_registered
      - incomplete_items_have_destination
      - blockers_are_registered
      - decisions_are_registered
      - backlog_is_updated
      - next_week_inputs_are_prepared
    fail_action: keep_cycle_open
# =====================================================================
# 12. TESTE DE UTILIDADE
# =====================================================================
utility_test:
  rule: >
    Cada item da folha deve apontar para uma ação, comando, workflow,
    decisão, estado, evidência ou resultado esperado.
  validation_questions:
    - O item possui um dono?
    - O item possui uma fonte?
    - O item ajuda Leonardo a decidir ou agir?
    - O item reduz incerteza ou carga cognitiva?
    - O item produz ou registra um resultado?
    - Existe uma próxima ação associada quando necessária?
    - O item continua útil sem conexão digital?
  reject_when:
    - field_has_no_owner
    - field_has_no_operational_purpose
    - item_has_no_source
    - actionable_item_has_no_next_action
    - field_duplicates_another_field_without_reason
    - runtime_value_was_invented
    - item_is_only_decorative
    - digital_dependency_breaks_offline_use
  rejection_action: remove_simplify_or_reassign
# =====================================================================
# 13. DEFINITION OF DONE DO CARD
# =====================================================================
definition_of_done:
  statement: >
    O DESK-OS está pronto para codificação quando suas três faces possuem
    função única, todos os campos têm dono e fonte, os três workflows atendem
    ao contrato de três etapas, os atalhos apontam para comandos válidos, a
    instância semanal não inventa dados, o QR possui fallback e o Recycle
    prepara o próximo ciclo.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - card_1_integration_is_explicit
    - weekly_instance_contract_is_complete
    - three_faces_are_defined
    - three_canonical_workflows_are_defined
    - ever

y_workflow_has_exactly_three_steps
    - weekly_grid_is_defined
    - today_and_close_day_are_defined
    - recycle_contract_is_complete
    - semantic_qr_contract_is_defined
    - ownership_map_is_complete
    - quality_gates_are_defined
    - utility_test_is_defined
    - no_runtime_value_is_fabricated
  status: codification_ready
